postResetAdversarialProof.allShapeCandidateReplacement: Every governed subject shape is driven through the production Assessment/Marking factory with an injected Assessment candidate-1 rejection and Marking Pack candidate-1 rejection for a real shape-derived slot; candidate 2 fills the same slot and the factory reaches validating with the complete expected set of accepted Assessment Items and Marking Packs.

postResetAdversarialProof.sharedFamilyMarkingRecovery: The language/text fixture uses one Question Family across two components. Rejecting Marking Pack candidate 1 for the second component leaves the first Marking Pack and both accepted Assessment Items intact; the exact accepted question wording remains frozen across Marking Pack attempts.
postResetAdversarialProof.boundedExhaustion: The science second Assessment slot rejects candidates 1 and 2. The course blocks explicitly, no candidate 3 exists, the accepted first Assessment sibling remains persisted, and no course-content-pack manifest is assembled.
postResetAdversarialProof.coverageInvariant: Rejected candidates never count as accepted Assessment or Marking Pack coverage. Successful shapes contain exactly the number of accepted artifacts required by their Assessment Blueprint targets; exhausted mandatory slots cannot be silently omitted.
